about_the_game:
Black Sun is a 70 pages PDF book set in the world of Plamen. A dramatic chronicle of Volkar the Brave, and his fight against the evil necromancer Kariasha.

Step beyond the battlefield and into the untamed lore of Plamen, a world where ancient rivalries burn, forgotten powers stir, and the shadow of the dark god Alaloth looms ever closer.

Alaloth: Tales is a book series that expands the universe of Alaloth: Champions of The Four Kingdoms, bringing to life the heroes, villains, and myths that shape this war-torn land.

Each volume unveils new legends, exploring the rise of The Four Kingdoms and the fractured bonds of gods and mortals.
